verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a downloadable tool that runs real conversions locally, and a community user notes it never hits a commercial paywall, so a developer can test real conversions without paying. However, the free/no-cost status rests only on a community comment rather than first-party license or pricing documentation, and the pack offers no formal free-tier, trial, or sandbox definition. missing for 10: first-party documentation of free/open-source licensing terms, independent corroboration of no-cost usage beyond a single comment.

support.subject: As a developer, a free tier, trial, or sandbox lets me test real conversions before paying

citations.quote: Converting video and audio has never been so easy.
